questions.question: / a). High energy recovery b). Toxic effluents c). Improved purity of productsd). Low carbon footprint Which is a limitation of mechanical recycling compared to chemical
questions.solution_html:
• b 21. a
  • Reduce the need for harmful chemicals like cyanide used in traditional leaching.
  • Advantages
  • - Environmentally friendly and cost-effective.
  • - Operates under mild conditions (ambient temperature and pressure).
  • - Produces less chemical waste.
  • Limitations
  • - Slower process rate compared to chemical leaching.
  • - Requires controlled environmental conditions (pH, temperature, nutrient supply).
  • Thus, bioleaching offers a sustainable approach for gold recovery from e-waste with minimal
  • ecological impact.
  • Dust and contamination risks: Air movement can disperse fine dust containing toxic
  • substances like lead, cadmium, and brominated flame retardants, posing health hazards to workers
  • and contaminating the workspace.
  • Power supply units (SMPS):Reusable after electrical testing and dust removal.
questions.final_answer: Power supply units (SMPS):Reusable after electrical testing and dust removal
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
